title: Warm Dutch Apple Fritters
description: Delicious crispy fritters filled with sweet apples, topped with a warm cinnamon sugar mixture. Perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together warm water, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
